Additionally, since no razzies are lazzies, it follows that there is no overlap between razzies and lazzies. Therefore, since all bloops are razzies and no razzies can be lazzies, it logically follows that no bloops can be lazzies either. 

In summary, no, none of the bloops can be lazzies.
